acv.quote: A hundred and eighty K a year, on a three-year term.

header.reason: A Fetchwell engineer built a working sitter pay flow over a weekend with our docs and sandbox. That turned a bake-off into a win. Priya called it clean, but PayPal, Venmo and saved-card questions stayed open.

findings.label: What started it
findings.finding: Lead with paying sitters locally without engineers babysitting the code.
findings.why: Fetchwell was launching Canada and the UK while two engineers just kept sitter payments working.
findings.quote: Two engineers more or less full-time just keeping sitter payments working.

findings.label: Who decided
findings.finding: Speak to the engineering lead about build speed, not finance.
findings.why: Daniel, VP of Engineering, signed. The CFO joined for ten minutes and asked one question.
findings.quote: this is an engineering decision, finance will sign what I bring them.

findings.label: The competitor
findings.finding: State plainly what happens to PayPal, Venmo and saved cards.
findings.why: After a Braintree call, Daniel's team asked what they would lose. Priya only guesses Braintree caused it.
findings.quote: It went from 'how fast can we build this' to 'what do we lose.'

findings.label: Our message
findings.finding: Cut the average acceptance-rate claim when bookings are small.

line.text: Authorization Boost increases acceptance rates by 3.8% on average

findings.why: Daniel waved off the acceptance-rate slide, while the docs and sandbox got the reaction.
findings.quote: our average booking is 38 dollars, I'm not losing sleep over auth rates.

findings.label: Missing proof
findings.finding: Add a story of a similar-size company moving saved cards safely.
findings.why: Daniel asked for one, Priya never answered, and it came up again at kickoff unresolved.
findings.quote: who's done this at our size without losing cards?

findings.label: Their words
findings.finding: Say 'sitter pay' and 'paid by Friday' instead of 'payouts'.

line.text: Instant payouts 24x7, including weekends and holidays

findings.why: Fetchwell says 'sitter pay' and 'the app', and the CFO only asked when sitters get paid.
findings.who: Fetchwell team, as reported by Priya, AE
